Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## Decision

JackiOh has no tagline. The owner ruled that no tagline is good enough to keep, and modern games mostly don't use one. "A duel of lanes, mana and hidden traps" goes, along with its variants. Don't swap in a new tagline anywhere. Where a sentence is needed, write a plain description of the game.

## What to change

1. **`apps/web/public/og.png`** (the 1200×630 share image that `og:image` points to). Remove the small gold eyebrow line "A DUEL OF LANES, MANA AND HIDDEN TRAPS" above the JackiOh wordmark. Keep everything else: the wordmark, the sentence under it, the fanned card backs, the background and the size (1200×630). Rebalance the left column's vertical spacing so it doesn't look like a line is missing. No generator for this image exists in the repo. Rebuild it as an HTML page rendered to PNG with the pre-installed headless Chromium (Playwright, `deviceScaleFactor: 1`, viewport 1200×630), or edit the existing PNG, whichever gives a cleaner result. If you write a generator, commit it under `scripts/` with a header comment so the image can be rebuilt later.
2. **The same phrase in the site text**, so it doesn't survive as copy:
   - `apps/web/static-pages.ts:91`: the landing section heading "A card game of lanes, mana and hidden traps" becomes a plain heading such as "How it plays". The body under it stays. `static-pages.test.ts` ("describe the game on the landing page…") must still pass.
   - `apps/web/static-pages.ts:46`, `apps/web/index.html` (meta description, `og:description` and the JSON-LD `description`) and `apps/web/public/manifest.webmanifest`: reword "a 1v1 card game of lanes, mana and hidden traps" into a plain description that doesn't reuse the tagline's wording, e.g. "JackiOh is a 1v1 card game where you summon units into lanes and set traps face down." Keep the rest of each description ("Play the AI in your browser with no account, or play friends online with an invite code."). Update any test that pins these strings.
   - `README.md:6-7`: "You can play hotseat, online, or against a practice AI." becomes plain wording without the jargon, e.g. "You can play a friend on one screen, play online, or practice against the AI."
3. **Write the decision down.** Add one line to `apps/web/README.md` saying the site and its images carry no tagline, so nobody adds one back.

## Acceptance

- `og.png` is 1200×630 with no eyebrow line, and the layout is otherwise unchanged. Attach a before/after screenshot to the pull request.
- `grep -rni "lanes, mana and hidden traps\|duel of lanes" apps README.md` finds nothing.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/static-pages.test.ts` and `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` pass.

4. In `apps/web/static-pages.ts`, replace line 46 with `JackiOh is a 1v1 card game where you summon units into lanes and set traps face down. Play the AI in your browser with no account, or play friends online with an invite code.` and line 91's heading with `How it plays`. Leave the body paragraphs under both untouched.
5. In `apps/web/index.html`, replace all three occurrences (meta description, `og:description`, JSON-LD `description`) with the exact string from step 4. `src/static-pages.test.ts` line 167 requires `PUBLIC_PAGES[0].description` to equal the template's meta description, so these must match character for character. 8. In `apps/web/README.md`, append to the `Player-facing words` section (after its last paragraph ending `…outside their allowlist.`): `The site and its images carry no tagline (#4653): where a sentence is needed, write a plain description of the game, and do not add one back.`
9. Produce the PR comparison: keep `/tmp/og-before.png` and the new file; note both paths and the `file` output in the final report so the deliver job can attach the before/after screenshot. Do not commit the before image.

## Tests

No test file changes: no test pins the old strings, and `src/static-pages.test.ts` reads `PUBLIC_PAGES` dynamically. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/static-pages.test.ts`, which covers the description-sync assertion and the `describe the game on the landing page…` test (its body-word assertions are unaffected since the body copy stays). Run `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`. Run `grep -rni "lanes, mana and hidden traps\|duel of lanes" apps README.md` and require empty output. Run `file apps/web/public/og.png` and require `1200 x 630`.

## Done when

- [ ] `og.png` is 1200×630, has no eyebrow line, and otherwise matches the original layout; before/after noted for the PR
- [ ] Generator committed under `scripts/` with a header comment
- [ ] Landing heading reads `How it plays`; body copy unchanged
- [ ] `static-pages.ts`, `index.html` (all three spots) and the manifest use the new plain descriptions; nothing reuses the tagline's wording and no new tagline was added
- [ ] `README.md` play-modes sentence and `apps/web/README.md` no-tagline line are in place
- [ ] The grep acceptance finds nothing; the vitest file and typecheck pass

## Risks

Chrome's `--window-size` can include window chrome and yield an off-by-a-few-pixels screenshot; if `file` reports anything but 1200×630, adjust the flag values until it is exact, keeping `deviceScaleFactor: 1` semantics. A full HTML rebuild cannot be pixel-identical (metallic wordmark gradient, star emblem); likeness is judged against `/tmp/og-before.png`, and fidelity of the untouched elements matters more than a fancy background. `apps/web/scripts/` holds the other asset generators, but the task names `scripts/`, so the generator goes in repo-root `scripts/`; either location passes all checks.
